title: monday_create_item.input
description: Input for the Monday.com create-item write tool. This is a WRITE-category tool: approval_required is true and execution is gated behind an approval record.

item_name.description: Human-readable task/action name (maps to the canonical Item column).

status.description: Canonical mesh status mapped to a Monday.com status label.

timeline.description: Planned start/end dates derived from task estimates and dependencies.

dependencies.description: Upstream task IDs or board item references.
